Rajasthan Conductor Result 2025 Out

The Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services Selection Board (RSMSSB) has announced the RSMSSB Conductor Result on 15 January. The result is published in PDF form and mentions qualifying status, cut-off marks, and details of the next selection stages. This announcement is important for candidates who appeared for the conductor recruitment under Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation (RSRTC). Candidates who qualify will be called for the document verification round.

RSMSSB Conductor Result @rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in

The RSMSSB Recruitment aims to fill 500 vacancies for the Conductor post. Candidates aspiring to join Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation as Conductors must qualify the RSMSSB Conductor examination. Check the table below for complete details related to the RSMSSB Conductor Result.

How to Check Rajasthan Conductor Result 2025?

Candidates can check the RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025 by following the steps mentioned below. The result is released either as a PDF merit list or via an online login portal. Follow the simple steps given below for easy access:

  1. Visit the official RSMSSB website: https://rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in
  2. Click on the “Results” section on the homepage.
  3. Find and click the link titled RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025.
  4. If the result is in PDF format:
    • Open and search for your Roll Number or Name.
  5. If login is required:
    • Enter your Application ID and Date of Birth.
  6. Check your qualifying status, marks (if shown), and category-wise details.
  7. Download or print the result for further use.

Details Mentioned in RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025

Once the Rajasthan Conductor Result is released, make sure you check the following details carefully:

  • Candidate’s Full Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Gender and Category
  • Marks Obtained (if displayed)
  • Qualifying Status
  • Cut-off Details (if applicable)
  • Instructions for Next Stage

What After RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025?

Candidates shortlisted in the Rajasthan Conductor results should start preparing for the next stages of the selection process. Candidates whose names appear in the merit list will be called for the Document Verification stage. They must carry original documents along with one set of photocopies, including 10th/12th marksheets, category and domicile certificates (if applicable), proof of age, a valid photo ID, recent passport-size photographs, and a valid conductor license, if required.

Rajasthan Conductor Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. What details are in the RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025?
Ans: RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025 is released online showing qualifying status, merit list, cut-off marks, and next selection stage details officially.

Q2. How can candidates download the RSMSSB Conductor Result 2025?
Ans: Candidates can download the result from official website by logging in with User ID and Password or accessing merit PDF.

Q3. When was the RSMSSB Conductor examination conducted?
Ans: The Rajasthan Conductor examination was conducted on 6th November 2025 for recruitment of conductors in Rajasthan Roadways Transport Corporation posts.

Q4. What is the next stage after qualifying the RSMSSB Conductor exam?
Ans: After qualifying, candidates are called for document verification carrying original certificates, photo ID, conductor license, and required photocopies documents stage.

Q5. What details are mentioned in the Rajasthan Conductor Result PDF?
Ans: RSMSSB Conductor Result PDF includes candidate name, roll number, category, marks, qualifying status, cut-off details, and further instructions for candidates.
